(* examples/washed/demo_prop_leak_washed.v — WASH-TARGET SPECIMEN
 *
 * Canonical mapping applied (README "Seven Canonical Steps", step 3):
 *   conclusion-position bare =  -> Id nat ... (proved via id_refl)
 *   conclusion-position nat <=  -> NatLe ... (proved via natle_ok)

patches.old:
*   scan   : expects conclusion-position RED hits (P4_bareeq / P5_le channels);
 *            premise-position hits are EXEMPT (lawful keep) per red-line-2.
 *   names  : expects exactly 5 top-level statements (N=5).
 *   wash   : the wash-target form is provided as washed/demo_prop_leak_washed.v
 *            (canonical mapping: conclusion bare = -> Id, conclusion nat <= -> NatLe).
 *   verify : the compile step runs under tools/cpu_guard.sh when rocq/coqc exists.
 *
 * Self-contained: Coq prelude only, no Require.
patches.new:
* NOTE: compile-ability of this specimen has NOT been verified
 * (no rocq/coqc on the authoring machine). `make verify` runs the
 * compile step automatically on a rocq-equipped machine.

patches.old: (* 1. bare <= in conclusion position -> scanner RED (P5_le) *)
Lemma demo_le_self : forall x : nat, x <= x.
patches.new: Lemma demo_le_self : forall x : nat, NatLe x x.

patches.old: (* 2. bare = in conclusion position -> scanner RED (P4_bareeq) *)
patches.new: (* 2. x = x  ->  Id nat x x *)

patches.old: Lemma demo_eq_self : forall x : nat, x = x.
patches.new: Lemma demo_eq_self : forall x : nat, Id nat x x.
(* 3. conclusion y = x -> Id nat y x; premise x = y stays lawful Prop *)

patches.old: Lemma demo_eq_sym : forall x y : nat, x = y -> y = x.
patches.new: Lemma demo_eq_sym : forall x y : nat, x = y -> Id nat y x.

patches.old: intros x y H. exact (eq_sym H).
patches.new: intros x y H. rewrite H. apply id_refl.

patches.old: Lemma demo_le_eq : forall x : nat, x <= x -> x = x.
patches.new: Lemma demo_le_eq : forall x : nat, NatLe x x -> Id nat x x.

patches.old: (* 5. <= on both sides: premise EXEMPT, conclusion RED (P5_le) *)
Lemma demo_mixed : forall x : nat, x <= x -> x <= x.
patches.new: Lemma demo_mixed : forall x : nat, NatLe x x -> NatLe x x.
